```sql
SELECT SUM("Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)") / SUM("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS free_meal_rate
FROM main."frpm" f
JOIN main."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s."OpenDate" <= DATE '2015-09-01'
  AND (s."ClosedDate" IS NULL OR s."ClosedDate" >= DATE '2015-09-01')
  AND s."Charter" = 1;
```
